method: Saved Chrome probe of a pending comparison interrupted by muted native playback or a dispatched pagehide event, with a controlled delay before real stem fetch/decode.
limitations: The captures cover the recorded interactions and timing sequences in Chrome.
Audio was routed to a zero-gain bus or muted native media. These are signal and control checks, not an audition.
Physical iPhone and Safari behavior, browser heap, and subjective musical expression were not measured.
A dispatched pagehide event tests the registered handler; it does not reproduce browser suspension or every navigation lifecycle.

result.method: Actual Chrome app and playback engine with a controlled wait before real stem fetch/decode. Native media played muted; pagehide was dispatched on the live test page.
